declaration.complete_rule: COVERAGE_COMPLETE requires admissible_rows == declared_rows exactly and zero defects. required_fraction is a floor for adjudication, not a licence to certify a short dataset as the declared one.

not_applied: no bar was re-fetched, no timestamp was synthesised, and no threshold moved. The alternatives in FINAL_REPORT §4 are proposals for the owner of the declaration, and none of them is implemented here.

phase_impact.reading: COVERAGE_COMPLETE requires admissible_rows == declared_rows exactly. Once a day is quarantined that equality is arithmetically unreachable, so the declaration as written can no longer be completed, whatever the remaining days do. The ceiling is computed by removing the lost days only; it assumes every remaining day arrives clean, which is an assumption, not a result.
